name: Crysta Snowpigeon
original_name: クリスタ＝スノーピジョン
source:
The Diamond Queen.
Her name is like the white dove of peace and her looks are pure, but what she desires is far from peace.
She loves to freeze things she is interested in and add them to her collection.
Right now the thing she wants to freeze most is Alice and Nightmare.
She appears sometimes as an adult and sometimes as a child.
